title: Standing at the Digital Threshold
description: Explore a picture of a student standing in a doorway between the everyday world and the digital world, and click each marker to learn about the digital threshold and the three steps of pause, think, act.
creator: Digital Citizenship for Grade 5 (ISD 197)
subject: digital citizenship
digital threshold
pause think act
learning_objective: Students will be able to identify the digital threshold as the moment right before they tap, click, share, or post, and recall the three steps of pause, think, act.
